cases.comparison: Exact literal r3 wrong-owner rejection: different owner and 0700 target, observed EACCES. A target directory open failure or missing relevant trace is incomplete, not a behavioral failure. Preserve earlier attributed mismatch through later infrastructure errors.
cases.oracle: Owned candidate trace with independently stat-bound foreign 0700 root and own 0700 positive root, PID/executable and user mapping; raw records require independent provenance and cleanup validation.
cases.purpose: Bounded wrong-owner ROOT rejection under UID-2000 mapped-user namespace, preserving prior lifecycle evidence.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU ]] || exit 125
